content: 'Ixaheritsixi Kanahani kememɨtehekuxei
Yawé Muitsexi mɨpaɨ katiniutahɨawe:
«Mɨpaɨ nepaine keniwaranunɨ'a hipame kwie memɨxeiyayukɨ 'ixaheritsixi nemɨwayetuirieni. Yuxexuime nuiwaritetsie memanuyetei mekaniwaranunɨ'akuni».
Yawé kemainekai, Muitsexi kaniwarenɨ'ani Parani makumawetsie mekaniyekɨne. Yunaitɨ mɨkɨ 'ixaheritsixi memanuyetei mekanihɨkɨtɨkaitɨni.
Mɨpaɨ mekatenitetewakaitɨni:
Tsamuha, Tsakuxi nu'aya, Xuweni nuiwarimama wahetsiemieme,
Tsapati, Huri nu'aya, Tsimehuni nuiwarimama,
Karewi, Kepune nu'aya, Kura nuiwarimama,
'Ikari, Kutse nu'aya, 'Itsakaxi nuiwarimama memɨhɨkɨ,
'Utseyaxi, Nuni nu'aya, 'Epɨrahini nuiwarimama memɨhɨkɨ,
Pariti, Xapuhu nu'aya, Wenikamini nuiwarimama,
Kariheri, Tsuhuri nu'aya, Tsawuruni nuiwarimama wahetsiemieme,
Kari, Tsutsi nu'aya, Manatsexi nuiwarimama (Kutse nu'aya xewitɨ mɨhɨkɨ),
'Amiheri, Kemari nu'aya, Rani nuiwarimama memɨhɨkɨ,
Tsetuxi, Mikaheri nu'aya, 'Atsexi nuiwarimama wahetsiemieme,
Nakiwi, Watsi nu'aya, Nepɨtahari nuiwarimama wahetsiemieme,
Kehueri, Maki nu'aya, Kahari nuiwarimama wahetsiemieme.
Mɨpaɨ mekatenitetewakaitɨni memanuyetei Muitsexi mɨwarenɨ'a kwie memɨxeiyayukɨ. ('Utseyaxi mɨtitewakai Nuni nu'aya, Muitsexi kanipata Kutsuhexi pɨta katiniterɨwa).
Kepauka Muitsexi mɨwarenɨ'a Kanani kwieyari memɨxeiyayukɨ, mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe: «Nekexi xekaneutiyunikuni, hɨritsie paitɨ xekaniye'axɨakuni.
Kwie naime xekenexeiya, xekeneyɨ'ɨwiya teɨteri kememe'anene, xɨka mehetɨrɨkawini yatɨ mepɨkatehetɨrɨkawi, xɨka meheyuwaɨkawani yatɨ 'etsi mepɨteheyupaɨme.
Xekenexeiya kwie keme'ane, xɨka 'aixɨa he'aneni yatɨ 'axapɨre'ane, xɨka waki hekurarutsietɨkani yatɨ pɨtikatixaɨ.

Kwie xekenexeiya xɨka 'aixɨa rexuaweriyani yatɨ hawaikɨ, xɨka kɨyexi hexuaweni yatɨ pɨremawe. Hikɨ xekenehu xekamamatɨ. Tixaɨtɨ 'ikwaxi xekateni'atuakuni muwa timieme». Mɨkɨ tukaritsie kaxie takari matɨari mieme matikwakwaxetsie mekaniyɨakaitɨni.
Mekanekɨne tamamata heimama huta meyupaɨmetɨ 'ukitsi kwie meheuxeiyayuka, makumawetsie Tsini Xekuwi ye'atɨkaime, Rewu Kamati heuhurakaku.

Nekexi mekaneutiyune, Hewuruni mekaniye'axɨani, 'Akimani, Tsetsahi meta Tarimahi memanu'uwakai 'Anaki nuiwarimama mematitekai. ('Epuruni kiekariyari meri kaniukamarieni 'ariketa 'atahuta wiyari 'anuyemiekaku Tsuhani kiekariyari kaniukamarieni 'Ekipitu mieme).

Kepauka memu'axɨa mayeweritsie 'akitsie 'Etsikuri, xeixatsimuyari mekanaka'inɨni kaxie takari, yuhutatɨ meneitɨni kɨyetsie me'iyewietɨ. Metatsiere hipame 'ikwaxite kɨranaraxi meta xapa takariyari mekanaka'inɨni.
'Ikɨ kaxie takari memaka'inɨikɨ 'ixaheritsixi, mana mekateniuterɨwa 'Etsikuri mayeweri.
Kememutiyua nenieremete
Huta tewiyari tukari 'anukayaku mekaniu'axɨani tamamata heimana huta 'ukitsi kwie mehekuxeiyaka.
Karetsi mekaniu'axɨani makumawetsie Parani Muitsexi manukatei, 'Aruni meta yunaitɨ 'ixaheritsixi, mekateniwarutaxatɨani kemɨre'anekai meta 'ikwaxite mekateniwaruxeitsitɨani mana mɨrexuawekai.
Mɨpaɨ mekateniwaruxatɨani: —Hakewa pemɨtatsihetanɨ'a mɨkɨ kwieyaritsie tepanɨkɨ, puyuri mana waɨkawa pexuawe retsi meta xiete. 'Ena xeketeneuxeiya 'ikwaxi mana mɨrexuawe.
Perutsɨ mana teɨteri memexuawe waɨkawa mepetɨrɨkawi, wakiekarite 'apɨremamariwawe, 'aixɨa rekukurarutsietɨkaitɨ. Matsita mana tekaniwarexeiya 'Anaki xiɨyarimama 'amemutɨtɨ.
'Amarekitsixi Nekexitsie mekaniu'uwani, hɨritsieta hetitsixi, kewutseutsixi meta 'amuxeutsixi hɨritsie mekane'uwani metatsiere kananeutsixi haramara tetsita mekaniu'uwani Kurutani tetsita.
Karewi kaiwatɨ katiniwaruyatsa 'ixaheritsixi Muitsexi hɨxie, mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: —Hikɨmɨtɨka tekanihuni mɨkɨ kwie tema'iwakɨ. Ne mɨpaɨ nepɨtiku'eriwa tepɨyɨwawe.
Hamatɨana memanɨkɨnekai mɨpaɨ mekaniutiyuani: —Tepɨkayɨwawe mɨkɨ teɨteri wahamatɨa temuyutakwini. Mɨkɨ mepɨtɨrɨkawi waɨkawa. Tame tepɨkatɨrɨkawi.
Hikɨ 'itarikakɨ mekateniutixatatɨkɨne 'ixaheritsixi watsata kwie memekuxei hepaɨtsita. Mɨpaɨ mekaniutiyuanekaitɨni: —Kwie temekuxei yuteɨterima kaniwarekwaka, teɨteri mana meme'uwa 'amekaniutɨni.
Matsi manata tekaniwarexeiya 'Anaki xiɨyarimama 'amemutɨtɨ. Temeyuku'inunɨatakai 'utsikari wahepaɨ tepepepekai, mɨpaɨ mɨkɨ mekatatenexeiyakaitɨni.
